name: Outside the Cave
description: A low cave mouth opens along the rocky coast. Dark water pools in the stone, and the air smells of salt and old rot. Old Lorek waits by his skiff, rope in hand—he'll row you back to the docks when you're ready.

interactables.name: Old Lorek's skiff
interactables.examine_text: Old Lorek waits by the skiff, refusing to look into the cave for long. When you're ready to leave, you can ask him to take you back to the docks.

talk.success_text: Old Lorek helps you into the skiff and rows you back to the docks without looking at the cave.
